text:
Marta Lopez: FYI we pushed ParcelX's LoRA merge (parcelx-lora-v1) into staging and the quick-eval pack flagged a reproducible enumeration formatting regression in short-list answers. Small sample and notes below.

Noah Kim: Can you paste the before/after? sounds like the kind of tokenization/merge edgecase we've seen but curious about the pattern.

Marta Lopez: baseline fp16: 
```
Q: List the steps to return an item.
A:
1. Pack the item securely.
2. Attach the return label.
3. Drop at the carrier.
```
int4 quickpack output (parcelx-lora-v1, quant int4-per-tensor):
```
Q: List the steps to return an item.
A:
1 Pack the item securely
2 Attach the return label
3 Drop at the carrier
```
Notice the enumerators lost the periods and commas and some newlines were collapsed. Quickpack metrics: enum-format accuracy dropped from 99.1% -> 94.6% (delta 0.045, threshold 0.02). Command: `./eval_quickpack --model parcelx-lora-v1 --quant int4 --prompts tests/parcelx_enum.json --seed 42`

devops-bot: CI: quick-eval for parcelx-lora-v1-int4 completed  status: FAIL. Artifacts: s3://redwood-qev/parcelx/v1/int4/enum_report.json

Asha Rao: That screams tokenizer boundary + quant rounding. The LoRA changes touched the embedding offsets for punctuation tokens (customer patch to boost locale token weights). Did the PR also include any merges to tokenizer merges or special-case punctuation mappings?

Marta Lopez: Yes, ParcelX asked for locale-aware punctuation boosting and we grafted a small adapter that reweights '.' and ',' embeddings + a tokenizer mapping tweak to prefer NFKC normalization for fullwidth punctuation. Both landed in the same branch.

Noah Kim: Plan: 1) reproduce with `--log-tokens --show-token-ids` to see if '.' and '1.' become separate tokens or combine, 2) bisect commits between adapter graft and tokenizer patch, 3) try a per-channel asymmetric quant and a narrow-range clipping to see if the punctuation embeddings saturate. I'll run step 1 and 3 in parallel.

devops-bot: Deployed shadow fp16 variant parcelx-lora-v1-fp16-shadow at 1767011140 for parallel smoke tests.

Asha Rao: Also try running the amalgamated text through our tokenizer sanity check: `tools/tokenizer_sanity --model parcelx-lora-v1 --mapping customers/parcelx/punct_map.json --sample tests/parcelx_enum.json`  if normalization changed NFKC handling we'll see codepoints remapped.

Marta Lopez: Kicking off the reproducer with log-tokens now. Will attach snippets. If we can confirm it's purely tokenization -> revert the tokenizer patch in a hotfix. If it's quantization amplifying a tiny embedding delta, we may need to rerun quant with per-channel scales and preserve zero-point per-block.

Noah Kim: Ran quantize: `quantize --model parcelx-lora-v1 --scheme per-channel-asym --clip 0.02 --out /tmp/pv1_pcq`  initial int4 per-channel run gives enum accuracy 97.8% (much better) but still slightly off compared to fp16. Will run a diff against token stream.

Marta Lopez: Logs from `--log-tokens` show that on failing outputs token ids for "1." became [57, 998] whereas baseline had a single id [1024] for the combined enumerator. That suggests tokenizer mapping order changed splitting multipoint tokens.

Asha Rao: Good catch. So root cause appears to be tokenizer mapping reorder. Sasha (cc) might want to re-order mappings so reserved enumeration tokens get precedence. Also we should add this enumerator test to our preflight quickpack for parcelx (tests/parcelx_enum.json).

Noah Kim: I'll open an internal PR that reorders mapping entries and include a regression test that asserts token id sequence for sample lines. If reordering isn't acceptable for ParcelX's locale request, fallback is to merge the adapter but force emit normalization to combine enumerators post-tokenize (ugly but workable).

devops-bot: Note: quickpack failure triggered enterprise-alert to Customer Success for ParcelX.

Marta Lopez: TL;DR action items: (1) Noah open PR reordering punct_map entries + add token-id regression test, (2) Noah re-run per-channel quant and push artifact if passed, (3) Marta add tests/parcelx_enum.json to CI quickpack, (4) Asha draft rollback plan if patch not acceptable. Will reconvene after PR review. :white_check_mark:
